lines.en: One flick of my tail and I dart off.
Three or five of us bunch together.
I swim along the stream stones.
A fallen leaf drifts past above.

lines.zh: 我跟着前头那条的尾巴。
lines.en: I follow the tail of the one ahead.
I slip through a clump of weeds.
The flow gave me a shove.
I edge toward the shallows.
One turn and I am heading elsewhere.
The streambed stones are slick.
I hug the shade along the bank.
I pass beneath the bridge.
Two more trail behind me.
I drift slowly downstream.
I tip up and glance at the sky.
I turn into the pool.
When I move, the water ripples.
I dive back to the deeper water.
I hover beside a stream stone.
My gill covers open and shut.
The water is just right for me.
I hold by the fallen log.
Our little group is spread through the water.
The stream never stops sounding.
I fan my tail slowly.
There is a leaf's shadow overhead.
I am neither large nor tiny.
The white sand below dazzles me.
I flatten my fins.
I float, tilted.
The current goes around me.

lines.zh: 我一动不动地停在水中。
lines.en: I hang motionless in the water.
You crouch at the stream to watch me.
The water shows half your face.
Your hands are empty.
I am shorter than your palm.
In a bucket I would be one small fish.
My name gets written on the bucket.
The bucket bears my Latin name.
I tuck into the shade of a stream stone.
When the water moves, I know.
Our group has seven or eight.
I burrow into the deepest weeds.
Two scales lifted away.
I spun once in place.
The water turned to silty fog.
My schoolmates burst apart.
I can still swim with my tail.
A thread of red hangs in the stream.
I shrink into a pebble gap.
That truly stung.
I slowly come round.
A small piece drops onto the water.
I turn a circle to look.
My schoolmates got there first.
Too small for a whole group.
I took one mouthful.
The crumbs drift off downstream.
I wait below for the crumbs.
More crumbs are sinking.
I edge up to it.
The taste is not quite right.
I hit a pebble and rolled over.
A string of bubbles rises.
I righted myself.
Your boot came down in the stream.
I darted to the far bank.
That scattered the group.
My side fin is numb.
I squeeze between the pebbles.
I have muddled the water.
I swim far off.
We swap places as we swim.
I keep to the weedy side.
We must all turn together.
The gentler water is best.
I will follow you a while.
The cracks are enough to hide in.
Our scales are much the same.
Farther downstream.
Do not dart so.
We swim bunched together.
I take it into my mouth.
This crumb is too hard.
I spit it out.
It settles between the pebbles.
I make a small circle around it.
I try one bite.
A size bigger than my mouth.
I push it into a pebble gap.
There is a trace of sweetness.
I cannot be bothered.
The stream's surface ripples wrong.
I lift my head and eye the shape above.
My schoolmates are sinking.
That shadow is too wide.
I duck into the weeds.
The surface is not calm.
My fins tightened.
That is nothing from this stream.
I back away, tail first.
The stones will cover me.
I keep watching that shadow.
It is bigger than the whole stream face.
I slide sideways along the streambed.
The group splits to both sides.
That shadow has turned.
I flatten my pectoral fins.
The weeds will hide me.
Move again and it sees.
I let it swim past.
The water dims.
I nudge it with my head.
This is all the strength I have.
My teeth are too fine to grip.
I lash it with my tail.
A small white burst churns up.
One strike and gone.
I dive into the thickest of the school.
My sight is blurring.
It did not follow.
I am still in the stream.
Fine shapes appear in the stream.
We swim out of the weed clump.
A little sand lifts off the bed.
I test the flow first.
Several form a little file.
The surface looks calm.
I flick my tail and lead.
A group hides under the fallen log.

lines.zh: 我自水草的暗影里冒出。
lines.en: I emerge from the shadow of the weeds.
This stretch is not deep.
Fire has sealed the stream's surface.
I was scooped up and dropped on the bank.
How is it I cannot breathe in water.
A layer of mud turns over on the bed.

lines.zh: 一支东西穿过溪水扎到我。
lines.en: Something cut through the water into me.
This light glows even on the streambed.
There is nothing to eat in this stretch.
White light struck the stream and I locked up.
No stream here, and no water.
